## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 1–4 are supported by the cited formal-document excerpts and correctly establish integral ideal generation, not the requested Schur-span equality.
- Claim 5’s DOI abstract contains neither a theorem locator nor coefficient hypotheses for \(J_v\); it cannot ground the requested identification.
- Claim 6 is a valid negative conclusion only for the narrowly supplied records. No external literature or arXiv search was executed, so the task’s required search was not completed.
- No verified arXiv identifier, full-text statement locator, or exact integral Littlewood–Richardson citation was obtained.
- The proposed equality is plausibly derivable from integral ideal generation plus LR closure of the indicated Schur span, but that reduction remains unsupported by the requested exact external locator.
